news.headline: ‘Magnifying smaller identities’: Mohan Bhagwat says efforts on to divide India using British-era tactics
news.story_lead: ‘Magnifying smaller identities’: Mohan Bhagwat says efforts on to divide India using British-era tactics RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat said that while India is moving in the right direction today, certain global forces do not want the nation to become great. Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) chief Mohan Bhagwat on Sunday stated that attempts are being made to divide India by magnifying smaller identities and inciting internal conflict, comparing such efforts to the divide-and-rule politics of British rule. Addressing the 'Maru Ninad-2026' Ghosh Shivir organised by the RSS Jodhpur Prant at Rajaram Ashram in Shikarpura, Bhagwat remarked that while India is moving in the right direction today, certain global forces do not want the nation to become great.
news.full_article_text: ‘Magnifying smaller identities’: Mohan Bhagwat says efforts on to divide India using British-era tactics RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat said that while India is moving in the right direction today, certain global forces do not want the nation to become great. Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) chief Mohan Bhagwat on Sunday stated that attempts are being made to divide India by magnifying smaller identities and inciting internal conflict, comparing such efforts to the divide-and-rule politics of British rule. Addressing the 'Maru Ninad-2026' Ghosh Shivir organised by the RSS Jodhpur Prant at Rajaram Ashram in Shikarpura, Bhagwat remarked that while India is moving in the right direction today, certain global forces do not want the nation to become great. "India is the treasure trove of everyone's hopes. But the state of the world is very strange. For their own selfish reasons, they don't even want India to become great. India moves forward; efforts are underway to create divisions by magnifying smaller identities and provoking conflict among people—tactics he compared to those used during British rule," the RSS Sarsanghchalak said. Urging society to remain united, Bhagwat stressed the need to shed selfishness, petty differences, and ego while building an organised life rooted in Dharma and national service. "Citing the Mahabharata, he noted that despite having a larger force of 11 Akshauhinis and stalwarts like Bhishma, Dronacharya, Karna, and Ashwatthama, the Kauravas lost because of internal discord. In contrast, the Pandavas won with seven Akshauhinis because they stayed united and resolved disputes to preserve harmony," he said. Highlighting the importance of grassroots leadership, Bhagwat said society follows trusted elders and role models. He stated that every village, street, and neighbourhood needs 25 to 100 selfless individuals of pure character who stand with people in times of joy and sorrow and are dedicated to the country. Referring to the principle that actions shape habits, habits shape nature, and nature builds character, he remarked that character is true strength. Speaking on the significance of the RSS Ghosh programme, Bhagwat traced the tradition of battlefield music to ancient texts like the Bhagavad Gita, citing the blowing of sacred conches such as Panchajanya and Devadatta. He noted that although early volunteers initially learned band tunes from British military bands, a sense of self-respect inspired them to create original martial compositions based on Indian classical music theory. He added that RSS band performers do not play for personal praise or applause, but to inculcate discipline, selflessness, teamwork, and a sense of collective progress.

news.headline: Uttarakhand MLA loses temper, vandalises stage after he was denied chance to speak at event; booked
news.story_lead: Uttarakhand MLA loses temper, vandalises stage after he was denied chance to speak at event; booked The chief minister lashed out at the Congress, saying it has lost its ground which is causing its members to “lose their mental balance”. Congress MLA Harish Dhami was on Sunday booked for allegedly vandalising a stage after he was "denied" an opportunity to speak in the presence of Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami, even as a war of words erupted between the BJP and the Congress over the incident at a prominent fair. The chief minister lashed out at the Congress, saying it has lost its ground which is causing its members to "lose their mental balance", while MLA Harish Dhami called the CM "darpok (coward)", accusing him of suppressing people's voice, and challenged the BJP leader to contest against him.
news.full_article_text: Uttarakhand MLA loses temper, vandalises stage after he was denied chance to speak at event; booked The chief minister lashed out at the Congress, saying it has lost its ground which is causing its members to “lose their mental balance”. Congress MLA Harish Dhami was on Sunday booked for allegedly vandalising a stage after he was "denied" an opportunity to speak in the presence of Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami, even as a war of words erupted between the BJP and the Congress over the incident at a prominent fair. The chief minister lashed out at the Congress, saying it has lost its ground which is causing its members to "lose their mental balance", while MLA Harish Dhami called the CM "darpok (coward)", accusing him of suppressing people's voice, and challenged the BJP leader to contest against him. Also read: Bengal police shoots dead ‘criminal’ who allegedly opened fire at cop two days ago; fifth encounter in 6 months The Congress said it stands strongly with its MLA "in the fight for the respect of its public representatives and the rights of the people". Insult to the opposition representatives through the administration will not be tolerated at any cost, state Congress president Ganesh Godiyal said. On Saturday, MLA Harish Dhami allegedly threw microphones and chairs on the stage after the chief minister left the venue and alleged that his mic was switched off as he was speaking. An FIR under relevant sections of the BNS was lodged against the Dharchula MLA and five others for vandalising the inauguration stage of Jauljibi Fair on Saturday following a complaint by Harendra Singh Negi, an officer at the Jauljibi police station. Also read: Punjab woman, accomplice held in Rajasthan train track blast; police suspect ISI's 'romance' strategy to recruit women The FIR has been filed under BNS sections 121 (voluntarily causing hurt ), 132 (assault to deter public servant from discharge of duty), 191(2) (rioting), 324(2) (property damage), and 352 (intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of the peace), according to Negi. Reacting to the incident, Dhami said, "Congress has crossed all boundaries of anarchy in every sphere, so this episode is also an example of the fact that in the coming days, public is going to reject them completely. "The Congress party has lost its ground, causing its members to lose their mental balance." "A behaviour that we would not even expect from a child is being displayed by Congress leaders, which is unheard of in a democracy... the same approach is followed by their leaders in Delhi.... Public is watching everything...," the CM told reporters in Dehradun. Hitting back, the Congress MLA said, "Till now people had heard that the CM is dhadak Dhami, but he is darpok Dhami." Also read: BJP targets Rahul Gandhi after Italian leader raises 'vote chor' slogan: 'Who laughs when India is insulted' In a social media post on Saturday, MLA Harish Dhami said that he wanted to raise two issues with the government: the death of an eight-year-old girl in the region two days before, and concerns regarding road connectivity in Kanar. He added that it is "deeply unfortunate that an elected representative was denied the opportunity to present the grievances" of their own constituents on the stage at the Jauljibi Fair. "Suppressing voices does not make questions disappear, and switching off a microphone cannot silence the voice of the people! news.headline: PM Modi, Trump to join ASEAN Summit in Manila; global conflicts, maritime, economic ties on agenda
news.story_lead: PM Modi, Trump to join ASEAN Summit in Manila; global conflicts, maritime, economic ties on agenda Modi will travel to Manila on November 16 to participate in the ASEAN-India Summit and the East Asia Summit the following day. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Manila on Monday for a three-day trip to attend the annual India-ASEAN Summit, which is expected to focus on strengthening maritime security ties and expanding economic and commercial partnerships. US President Donald Trump, Brazil’s Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney are also expected to attend the summit.
news.full_article_text: PM Modi, Trump to join ASEAN Summit in Manila; global conflicts, maritime, economic ties on agenda Modi will travel to Manila on November 16 to participate in the ASEAN-India Summit and the East Asia Summit the following day. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Manila on Monday for a three-day trip to attend the annual India-ASEAN Summit, which is expected to focus on strengthening maritime security ties and expanding economic and commercial partnerships. US President Donald Trump, Brazil’s Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney are also expected to attend the summit. What's on PM Modi's agenda Modi will travel to Manila on November 16 to participate in the ASEAN-India Summit and the East Asia Summit the following day, on the margins of the ASEAN Summit being hosted by the Philippines. He is also expected to join the leaders of Australia, Japan and the US for a Quad Leaders’ Summit and hold several bilateral meetings. Throughout the India-ASEAN and East Asia summits, New Delhi is looking to boost naval and maritime coordination among like-minded Indo-Pacific states. What is ASEAN ASEAN or the Association of Southeast Asian Nations is one of the most significant geopolitical blocs in the region. The group primarily comprises Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia, Singapore, Brunei, Thailand, Vietnam, Myanmar, Laos, Cambodia and East Timor. New Delhi will be joining major global powers, including Washington, Beijing, Tokyo and Canberra, as an official dialogue partner. Prominent world leaders to gather in Manila Global delegations have steadily arrived in the country ahead of the main event, with representatives from ASEAN member states, dialogue partners and international organisations preparing for a packed itinerary of high-level meetings from November 15 to November 17, according to Philippine News Agency. The three-day summit, which includes scheduled talks with world leaders, including US President Donald Trump, will focus on conflicts, including the war in Myanmar, The Associated Press reported citing drafts of post-summit communiques. Trump, Brazil’s President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, Canada’s Carney and Russian foreign minister Sergey Lavrov also feature on the roster for November 17. What's on agenda for ASEAN ASEAN has emerged as a central pillar of India’s Act East policy and vision for the Indo-Pacific, and Rudrendra Tandon, secretary (East) in the external affairs ministry, told a media briefing that the 11-member bloc serves as a “locomotive for peace, stability and economic prosperity”. Annual trade between India and ASEAN member states is worth about $122 billion. “India strongly believes that as an Indian Ocean country that abuts this very important Southeast Asian maritime zone, a strong strategic relationship with ASEAN member states, as a collective as well as individually, is good for both of us,” Tandon said. “It will make us more resilient to handle the very rapid geopolitical changes that are taking place around us. It will also contribute to peace and stability in Asia as a whole.” According to the senior official, strengthening maritime defence mechanisms and commercial exchanges will be among the key agendas during the deliberations. Serving as the premier diplomatic platform across the Asia-Pacific for addressing defence and security challenges, the East Asia Forum has fundamentally shaped regional strategic evolution since its launch in 2005. Alongside the core Southeast Asian member countries, the wider regional dialogue framework encompasses New Delhi, Beijing, Tokyo, Seoul, Canberra, Wellington, Washington and Moscow, bringing together all ASEAN member states. In the context of trade with the Southeast Asian block, Tandon said New Delhi wants the review of the ASEAN India Trade in Goods Agreement (AITIGA) to be completed “as soon as possible”. India is also engaged in discussions with individual ASEAN member states for trade facilitation and trade agreements to open up new opportunities, he said. Tandon acknowledged that the review of AITIGA is a “difficult” process as it involves developing consensus with all ASEAN member states. AITIGA entered into force in 2010 and the review began six years ago, largely because of India’s concerns about trade imbalance due to imports of more than $80 billion from ASEAN member states. Asked about India’s position on dealing with the situation in Myanmar, Tandon said: “We have always said that isolating Myanmar is not the right approach because if we do, someone else will fill that vacuum. There is no alternative to engagement.” India strongly supports ASEAN initiatives to engage the Myanmar government, while taking into account the country’s complex history and society. “Patience and consistency in engagement is very important,” Tandon said. Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Manila on Monday for a three-day trip to attend the annual India-ASEAN Summit, which is expected to focus on strengthening maritime security ties and expanding economic and commercial partnerships.
US President Donald Trump, Brazil’s Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney are also expected to attend the summit.
Modi will travel to Manila on November 16 to participate in the ASEAN-India Summit and the East Asia Summit the following day, on the margins of the ASEAN Summit being hosted by the Philippines.
He is also expected to join the leaders of Australia, Japan and the US for a Quad Leaders’ Summit and hold several bilateral meetings.
Throughout the India-ASEAN and East Asia summits, New Delhi is looking to boost naval and maritime coordination among like-minded Indo-Pacific states.

ASEAN or the Association of Southeast Asian Nations is one of the most significant geopolitical blocs in the region. The group primarily comprises Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia, Singapore, Brunei, Thailand, Vietnam, Myanmar, Laos, Cambodia and East Timor.

news.full_article_text: Depression over Bay of Bengal likely to intensify into severe cyclonic storm by Nov 17, move towards Andhra Pradesh coast: IMD The weather system is likely to become a Severe Cyclonic Storm over the westcentral Bay of Bengal by the evening of November 17, the IMD said. A depression over the Bay of Bengal is likely to strengthen into a cyclonic storm by the evening of November 16 and further intensify into a severe cyclonic storm by November 17, before moving towards the Andhra Pradesh coast over the following two days, the India Meteorological Department (IMD) said on Sunday. The weather system is expected to move north-northwestwards as it gains strength over the central parts of the south and adjoining west central Bay of Bengal. It is likely to become a severe cyclonic storm over the west-central Bay of Bengal by the evening of November 17, the IMD said. "The Depression over Southeast & adjoining Southwest Bay of Bengal moved north-northwestwards with the speed of 07 kmph during past06 hours and lay centered at 1730 hours IST of today, the 15thNovember, 2026 over the same region, near Latitude 10.2°N and Longitude 86.8°E,about 630 km east-northeast of Trincomalee (Sri Lanka), 670km west-southwest of Sri Vijaya Puram (Andaman & Nicobar Islands), 780 km east-southeast of Chennai(Tamil Nadu), 920 km south-southeast of Visakhapatnam (Andhra Pradesh) and 1030km south-southeast of Gopalpur (Odisha)," the IMD said. "It is very likely to move north-northwestwards, intensify further into a Cyclonic Storm over the central parts of south & adjoining west central Bay of Bengal on evening of 16th November and into a Severe Cyclonic Storm over west central Bay of Bengal on evening of 17th November, 2026. Thereafter, it is likely to intensify further and move northwestwards towards Andhra Pradesh coast during subsequent2 days," the IMD further added. Naidu seeks financial assistance Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu on Sunday sought urgent financial assistance from the Centre for relief and rehabilitation work after Cyclone Murasu caused estimated damage of ₹ 2,484.43 crore in the state, news agency PTI reported. A seven-member Central team, led by Chittaranjan Das, Joint Secretary in the Union Home Ministry, held a virtual meeting with the Chief Minister after inspecting nearly 60 locations across Bapatla, Palnadu, Eluru and East Godavari districts. The Central team inspected damaged agricultural fields, canals, roads and houses. It also interacted with farmers at Surappagudem and visited paddy fields at Ravulapalem, the Kommu canal, irrigation works at Kunakalamarri and fishing boats at Chirala. The team assessed damage to houses, horticultural crops, farms and duck-rearing units at Boppudi. It also inspected roads crossing the Jaladi stream between Yedlapadu and Turlapadu. Naidu said El Nino conditions and two cyclones hitting the state within a short period had contributed to the widespread damage. He said the state government had taken precautionary measures in advance and started restoration work immediately after the cyclone. Road connectivity, electricity supply and mobile networks were restored within 24 hours, the Chief Minister said. news.headline: South Korea's top scorer in tax accountancy exam admits cheating
news.story_lead: Han Won-seok confessed in a video on the YouTube channel of his lawyer - Published 5 hours ago A candidate who came first in South Korea's certified tax accountancy exam has admitted cheating by using a miniature camera, mobile phone and AI tools. Han Won-seok confessed in a video on the YouTube account of his lawyer, Lee Don-Ho, adding that he had confessed to the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency and offered details on how he cheated. The 34-year-old scored 397.5 out of 400 points in the first round, getting just one of 160 questions wrong, which initially raised suspicions and sparked online speculation.
news.full_article_text: Han Won-seok confessed in a video on the YouTube channel of his lawyer - Published 5 hours ago A candidate who came first in South Korea's certified tax accountancy exam has admitted cheating by using a miniature camera, mobile phone and AI tools. Han Won-seok confessed in a video on the YouTube account of his lawyer, Lee Don-Ho, adding that he had confessed to the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency and offered details on how he cheated. The 34-year-old scored 397.5 out of 400 points in the first round, getting just one of 160 questions wrong, which initially raised suspicions and sparked online speculation. Standardised national tests play an outsized role in career trajectories for South Koreans, making their results - and efforts to unduly inflate those results - of great importance. "I cheated in both the first and second rounds of the tax account exam by using electronic devices and generative AI," Han said in the video published on Sunday. "I used a microcamera to photograph the test questions and sent them to an AI then checked my answers on my smartphone to commit the cheating." When accusations he had cheated first began to surface, Han had denied any wrongdoing - but said he had changed his mind after thinking about the feelings of the candidate who had come second in the exam. He went on to apologise to the other entrants who had passed the tests fairly. "It seems that because of me, other successful candidates are being suspected," he suggested. The Ministry of Employment and Labour and the Human Resources Development Service held an emergency meeting after Han admitted cheating. The South Korean president's policy chief Ha Jun-kyung said new measures would be introduced to prevent cheating and warned "past crimes" would be "tracked down and apprehended to the very end". Those found to have used AI to cheat in the tax accountancy exam will have their qualification revoked and will be banned from retaking the test for five years, the government said. The scandal comes just days before the east Asian nation's annual college entrance exam, a crucial hurdle for students. Can smart glasses exam cheating be stopped? A series of cases involving exam cheating with AI glasses in South Korea has universities and schools scrambling to rein in the use of the technology. Han said he had only cheated to try and earn money and get a job that would make his parents proud of him again. Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency told Korean news agency Yonhap on Sunday that it was looking into the case. "We received a written confession through the test taker's lawyer this morning regarding cheating on the tax accountant exam," it confirmed in a statement. It added that the case had now been assigned to investigators. Because of the significance of the national exams, instances of cheating are not uncommon in South Korea, and cases involving the use of AI have become more prominent as the technology becomes more sophisticated. Last month, two college applicants were reported to have used AI glasses to try and cheat their entrance exams at two Seoul universities. Education ministry data also says there were four cases of cheating through AI glasses at middle and high schools in the past 12 months. hindi_translation.full_article_text: Han Won-seok confessed in a video on the YouTube channel of his lawyer - Published 5 hours ago A candidate who came first in South Korea's certified tax accountancy exam has admitted cheating by using a miniature camera, mobile phone and AI tools. Han Won-seok confessed in a video on the YouTube account of his lawyer, Lee Don-Ho, adding that he had confessed to the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency and offered details on how he cheated. The 34-year-old scored 397.5 out of 400 points in the first round, getting just one of 160 questions wrong, which initially raised suspicions and sparked online speculation. Standardised national tests play an outsized role in career trajectories for South Koreans, making their results - and efforts to unduly inflate those results - of great importance. "I cheated in both the first and second rounds of the tax account exam by using electronic devices and generative AI," Han said in the video published on Sunday. "I used a microcamera to photograph the test questions and sent them to an AI then checked my answers on my smartphone to commit the cheating." When accusations he had cheated first began to surface, Han had denied any wrongdoing - but said he had changed his mind after thinking about the feelings of the candidate who had come second in the exam. He went on to apologise to the other entrants who had passed the tests fairly. "It seems that because of me, other successful candidates are being suspected," he suggested. The Ministry of Employment and Labour and the Human Resources Development Service held an emergency meeting after Han admitted cheating. The South Korean president's policy chief Ha Jun-kyung said new measures would be introduced to prevent cheating and warned "past crimes" would be "tracked down and apprehended to the very end". Those found to have used AI to cheat in the tax accountancy exam will have their qualification revoked and will be banned from retaking the test for five years, the government said. The scandal comes just days before the east Asian nation's annual college entrance exam, a crucial hurdle for students. Can smart glasses exam cheating be stopped? A series of cases involving exam cheating with AI glasses in South Korea has universities and schools scrambling to rein in the use of the technology. Han said he had only cheated to try and earn money and get a job that would make his parents proud of him again. Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency told Korean news agency Yonhap on Sunday that it was looking into the case. "We received a written confession through the test taker's lawyer this morning regarding cheating on the tax accountant exam," it confirmed in a statement. It added that the case had now been assigned to investigators. Because of the significance of the national exams, instances of cheating are not uncommon in South Korea, and cases involving the use of AI have become more prominent as the technology becomes more sophisticated. Last month, two college applicants were reported to have used AI glasses to try and cheat their entrance exams at two Seoul universities. Education ministry data also says there were four cases of cheating through AI glasses at middle and high schools in the past 12 months. news.full_article_text: India’s health spending triples to ₹4.14L cr, out-of-pocket spending drops to 42.7%: NHA India’s health spending triples to ₹ 4.14L cr, out-of-pocket spending drops to 42.7%: NHA New Delhi, The Centre's health expenditure more than tripled to ₹ 4.14 lakh crore in 2023-24 from ₹ 1.30 lakh crore in 2013-14, while the share of out-of-pocket spending by households dropped by 21.5 percentage points in the same period, the latest National Health Accounts estimates showed. The National Health Accounts Estimates for India 2023-24, released by the Union Health Ministry, showed that out-of-pocket expenditure as a share of total health expenditure fell from 64.2 per cent in 2013-14 to 42.7 per cent in 2023-24, highlighting a significant transformation in the country's healthcare financing landscape. "Between 2013-14 and 2023-24, government health expenditure increased from approximately ₹ 1.30 lakh crore to ₹ 4.14 lakh crore. "The simultaneous increase in public healthcare financing and decline in the proportion of spending borne directly by households reflect India's progress towards a more accessible, affordable and financially protective healthcare system," the health ministry said in a statement. According to the estimates, the OOPE declined from 43.4 per cent in 2022-23 to 42.7 per cent in 2023-24, indicating a continued reduction in the proportion of healthcare costs directly borne by households. "The sustained downward trend reflects the expanding role of government-supported healthcare services and financial protection mechanisms. "Initiatives aimed at improving access to free and affordable treatment, medicines, diagnostics and hospital services are supporting efforts to reduce dependence on direct household spending," the ministry said. The government's share in total health expenditure also increased by 14.9 percentage points over the decade, the estimates showed, while per capita government health expenditure rose from ₹ 1,042 in 2013-14 to ₹ 2,959 in 2023-24, an increase of nearly three times. The estimates also highlighted a rise in social security expenditure on health, with its share in total health expenditure increasing from 6 per cent in 2013-14 to 11 per cent in 2023-24. This includes government-financed health insurance schemes, such as the Ayushman Bharat-Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana, state insurance schemes, social health insurance and medical expenditure for government employees. Private health insurance expenditure also increased, with its share of total health expenditure rising from 3.4 per cent in 2013-14 to 10.2 per cent in 2023-24, the estimates showed. The government expenditure on primary healthcare stood at around ₹ 1.53 lakh crore in 2023-24, underscoring the increased focus on primary and community-level healthcare, the ministry said. Initiatives such as Ayushman Arogya Mandirs, free drugs and diagnostics, the Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme, Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana and AMRIT pharmacies have contributed to efforts to improve access to affordable healthcare, it said. news.headline: Donald Trump's Final Push for Judicial Appointments Faces Resistance from Senate Republicans
news.story_lead: Donald Trump's initiative to rapidly confirm federal judicial nominees during the final stage of his mandate has encountered significant obstacles within the US Senate. Key Republican lawmakers have raised objections, stalling the last-minute judicial blitz.
news.full_article_text:
### US Judicial Appointment Blitz

Efforts by Donald Trump to fast-track the confirmation of federal judges have run into opposition within the United States Senate. The last-minute push aimed to secure conservative lifetime appointments across the federal judiciary before the legislative term concluded.

### Intra-Party Roadblocks in the US Senate

- **Legislative Challenges:** Under the US constitutional framework, all presidential nominees for federal judgeships require approval from the Senate.
- **Republican Objections:** Opposition from within Republican ranks has created significant hurdles, preventing several nominees from receiving swift confirmations.
- **Significance:** The resistance underscores intra-party friction regarding the nomination of controversial judicial candidates during transitional or late-stage legislative sessions.
bullet_points: Donald Trump launched a late push to confirm federal judicial nominees in the US Senate.
The initiative encountered unexpected resistance from members of the Republican Party.
US federal judges are nominated by the President and must be confirmed by the Senate.
Republican roadblocks have delayed and threatened the final confirmation of several nominees.
Federal judicial appointments carry lifetime tenure under the US Constitution.
The event highlights executive-legislative friction during judicial appointment drives.
key_facts: Donald Trump initiated a last-minute effort to confirm federal judicial candidates.
Republican senators created roadblocks delaying the judicial appointment process.
US federal judicial confirmations require approval by the United States Senate.
exam_relevance: Illustrates comparative constitutional processes regarding judicial appointments and executive-legislative checks and balances in presidential systems.
news.upsc_analysis: The scenario demonstrates the application of checks and balances in the American political system, where even majority party members in the legislature can exercise independent scrutiny over executive judicial nominations.
causes: Donald Trump's effort to fast-track federal judge confirmations before the end of the legislative session.
Intra-party disagreements and concerns among Republican senators regarding specific judicial candidates.
impacts: Delays and potential failures in confirming proposed federal judges to lifetime seats.
challenges: Securing majority consensus in the Senate amidst intra-party opposition during late-stage confirmation drives.
constitutional_or_policy_link: Article II, Section 2 of the United States Constitution (Appointments Clause).
news.mains_notes:
### US Judicial Confirmation Process
- **Constitutional Provision:** Article II, Section 2 mandates presidential nomination and Senate confirmation ('Advice and Consent') for federal judges.
- **Tenure:** US federal judges hold lifetime appointments.
- **Key Issue:** Last-minute judicial appointment blitz faced roadblocks due to internal opposition among Senate Republicans.
mains_questions: Examine the system of checks and balances between the executive and legislative branches in the United States regarding judicial appointments.
How does intra-party opposition influence legislative confirmations of executive nominees in presidential democracies?
news.takeaway: Donald Trump's late push to confirm federal judges faced unexpected opposition from within the Republican-led Senate.
prelims_facts: In the US, federal judicial nominations require confirmation by the United States Senate under Article II of the US Constitution.
US federal judges receive lifetime appointments upon confirmation.

hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### अमेरिकी न्यायिक नियुक्ति अभियान

डोनाल्ड ट्रंप द्वारा संघीय न्यायाधीशों की त्वरित पुष्टि कराने के प्रयासों को अमेरिकी सेनेट में विरोध का सामना करना पड़ा है। इस अभियान का उद्देश्य कार्यकाल समाप्त होने से पहले संघीय न्यायपालिका में आजीवन नियुक्तियां सुरक्षित करना था।

### रिपब्लिकन पार्टी के भीतर रुकावटें

- **विधायी चुनौतियां:** अमेरिकी संवैधानिक ढांचे के तहत, संघीय न्यायाधीशों की सभी राष्ट्रपति नियुक्तियों के लिए सेनेट की मंजूरी आवश्यक होती है।
- **रिपब्लिकन आपत्तियां:** रिपब्लिकन पार्टी के भीतर से ही हुए विरोध ने कई नामांकनों की त्वरित पुष्टि को रोक दिया है।
- **महत्व:** यह विरोध संवेदनशील न्यायिक उम्मीदवारों के नामांकन पर पार्टी के आंतरिक मतभेदों को दर्शाता है।

इस प्रयास को रिपब्लिकन पार्टी के सदस्यों के विरोध का सामना करना पड़ा।

news.headline: US Claims of Iranian Weapon Destruction Contrast with Reports of 2,500 Retained Missiles
news.story_lead: Donald Trump claimed that United States military actions succeeded in destroying Iran's weapon stockpiles. However, operational reports and intelligence estimates indicate that Iran still maintains an arsenal of approximately 2,500 missiles.
news.full_article_text:
### Overview of Statements and Missile Arsenal Estimates

Recent statements regarding US strategic actions against Iranian military infrastructure have highlighted differing assessments of Iran's residual strike capabilities.

* **Public Claims:** Donald Trump asserted that military strikes conducted by the United States had effectively destroyed Iran's weapons assets.
* **Reported Inventory:** Contrary to claims of complete destruction, assessments indicate that Iran retains a substantial stockpile estimated at 2,500 missiles.
* **Security Implications:** The retention of 2,500 missiles underscores the persistence of Iran's missile program as a central factor in West Asian regional security dynamics and highlights the difficulty of completely neutralizing distributed missile inventories.
bullet_points: Donald Trump claimed that US operations effectively destroyed Iran's weapons capability.
Reports indicate Iran continues to hold an estimated stockpile of 2,500 missiles.
The discrepancy emphasizes the challenge of battle damage assessment in strategic strikes.
Iran's retained missile inventory remains a key component of regional military deterrence.
key_facts: Claim: US destroyed Iran's weapons.
Fact/Estimate: Iran still possesses approximately 2,500 missiles.
important_dates: 2026-11-15 (Publication date)
exam_relevance: Useful for tracking international security developments, strategic missile capabilities, and West Asian regional dynamics.
news.upsc_analysis: The gap between public declarations of destroyed military infrastructure and independent estimates of persistent missile arsenals illustrates the complexities of strategic damage verification and regional deterrence in modern warfare.
causes: US military operations targeting Iranian defensive and strategic weapon infrastructure.
impacts: Continued strategic capability and missile deterrence maintained by Iran despite military pressure.
challenges: Accurately evaluating residual military capabilities following targeted strategic strikes.
way_forward: Rely on verified multi-source intelligence assessments to evaluate regional arms control and security threats.
news.mains_notes: Discrepancies in post-strike damage evaluation highlight the challenges in neutralizing mobile and underground missile inventories in West Asia.
mains_questions: Analyze the strategic significance of ballistic and cruise missile proliferation in West Asian geopolitical dynamics.
Discuss the challenges associated with battle damage assessment and military intelligence verification in modern warfare.
news.takeaway: Despite claims of complete destruction by the US, Iran is estimated to retain a stockpile of 2,500 missiles.
prelims_facts: Iran retains an estimated arsenal of 2,500 missiles despite claimed destruction of its weaponry.

ईरानी सैन्य बुनियादी ढांचे के खिलाफ अमेरिकी रणनीतिक कार्रवाइयों के संबंध में हालिया बयानों ने ईरान की अवशिष्ट मारक क्षमताओं के अलग-अलग आकलन को रेखांकित किया है।

* **सार्वजनिक दावे:** डोनल्ड ट्रंप ने दावा किया कि संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका द्वारा किए गए सैन्य हमलों ने ईरान के हथियार संपत्तियों को प्रभावी ढंग से नष्ट कर दिया था।
* **अनुमानित भंडार:** पूर्ण विनाश के दावों के विपरीत, आकलन बताते हैं कि ईरान लगभग 2,500 मिसाइलों का एक बड़ा भंडार बनाए हुए है।
* **सुरक्षा निहितार्थ:** 2,500 मिसाइलों का यह भंडार पश्चिम एशियाई क्षेत्रीय सुरक्षा गतिशीलता में ईरान के मिसाइल कार्यक्रम के महत्व को बनाए रखता है।

### सीओपी17 संगोष्ठी में भारत के प्रतिनिधित्व का अवलोकन

न्यायमूर्ति प्रकाश श्रीवास्तव ने पर्यावरण संरक्षण के लिए कानूनी तंत्र पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हुए आर्मेनिया में सीओपी17 सम्मेलन के दौरान आयोजित एक विशेष न्यायिक संगोष्ठी में भारत का प्रतिनिधित्व किया।

### संबोधन के प्रमुख बिंदु

* **पर्यावरण न्यायशास्त्र**: भारत में पर्यावरण कानून और न्यायशास्त्र के विकासवादी पथ पर प्रकाश डाला गया।
* **न्यायिक मंच**: आर्मेनिया में सीओपी17 के साथ आयोजित न्यायिक संगोष्ठी में भाग लिया।
* **वैश्विक पारिस्थितिक शासन**: सतत विकास और जलवायु न्याय प्राप्त करने में न्यायिक निगरानी और विशेष न्यायाधिकरणों की भूमिका पर जोर दिया।
bullet_points: न्यायमूर्ति प्रकाश श्रीवास्तव ने आर्मेनिया में सीओपी17 में आयोजित न्यायिक संगोष्ठी को संबोधित किया।
संबोधन में भारत के पर्यावरण न्यायशास्त्र और न्यायिक ढांचे की भूमिका पर प्रकाश डाला गया।
इस कार्यक्रम में जलवायु परिवर्तन और पारिस्थितिक कानून के संबंध में न्यायिक निकायों के बीच अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सहयोग पर बल दिया गया।
यह भागीदारी वैश्विक पर्यावरण शासन में भारत की सक्रिय भागीदारी को दर्शाती है।
key_facts: न्यायमूर्ति प्रकाश श्रीवास्तव ने पर्यावरण संरक्षण में भारत की कानूनी और न्यायिक उपलब्धियों को प्रस्तुत किया।

news.headline: Parliament Winter Session Expected in December; Government Targets Passage of Delimitation-Linked Women's Quota Bill
news.story_lead: The Winter Session of Parliament is likely to begin in the first week of December, with the Union government prioritizing a Constitution Amendment Bill linked to delimitation and women's reservation. The bill aims to expand the Lok Sabha's seat strength up to 850 and operationalize a 33 per cent quota for women ahead of the 2029 general elections.
news.full_article_text:
### Parliament Winter Session & Proposed Delimitation-Linked Women's Quota Bill

The Union government is preparing to convene the Winter Session of Parliament in the first week of December, placing a major legislative focus on passing a constitutional amendment bill tied to electoral delimitation and women's political representation.

#### Key Objectives & Proposed Provisions
* **Expansion of Lok Sabha Seats**: The legislation seeks to expand the maximum seat capacity of the Lok Sabha from the present 543 seats to up to 850 seats via delimitation.
* **Implementation of Women's Quota**: The structural expansion is intended to facilitate 33 per cent reservation for women in Parliament and state legislatures prior to the 2029 general elections.
* **Proposed Delimitation Formula**: The government is examining a formula to increase Lok Sabha seats by 50 per cent across all states, while retaining the inter-state seat distribution ratio established under the 1971 Census to address regional demographic concerns, particularly from southern states.

#### Numerical Dynamics in Lok Sabha
* **Special Majority Requirement**: A Constitution Amendment Bill requires a two-thirds majority of members present and voting, amounting to 361 votes in a full 543-member Lok Sabha.
* **Current Strength & Vacancies**: The Lok Sabha currently has 540 members due to 3 existing vacancies.
* **Coalition Position**: The ruling National Democratic Alliance (NDA) holds 320 members and requires opposition support to cross the 361-vote mark. Government sources anticipate securing the bill with a margin of 15 to 18 votes.
* **Previous Vote Outcome**: An earlier attempt to pass the legislation during a special sitting on April 17 failed to achieve the necessary votes.

#### Procedural Status of the Previous Session
* **Unprorogued Record**: The previous Monsoon Session was adjourned sine die on August 13 and remained unprorogued for 94 days, breaking the previous record of 87 days established in 2008.
* **Notice Rules**: Under parliamentary rules, an extended sitting of an unprorogued session can be called with a minimum of 2 days' notice, whereas summoning a fresh session requires at least 14 days' notice.
* **Constitutional Standard**: The Constitution does not specify a fixed timeline for the President to prorogue a House after it is adjourned sine die.

#### Political Challenges & Friction
* Opposition parties are conducting campaigns against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls and demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, signaling potential disruptions during the upcoming session.

news.upsc_analysis: The proposed delimitation-linked women's reservation bill represents a significant structural reform in Indian governance. By linking the expansion of Lok Sabha seats (up to 850) with 33% female representation, the government aims to fulfill long-pending gender parity commitments before the 2029 elections. However, delimitation introduces complex inter-state equity challenges: states with effective population management (notably in Southern India) fear losing proportional representation relative to higher-population northern states. The proposed formula—increasing seats by 50% while preserving the 1971 Census ratio—attempts to balance demographic reality with federal harmony.

hindi_translation.story_lead: संसद का शीतकालीन सत्र दिसंबर के पहले सप्ताह में शुरू होने की संभावना है। सरकार परिसीमन और महिला आरक्षण से जुड़े संविधान संशोधन विधेयक को प्राथमिकता दे रही है। इस विधेयक का उद्देश्य 2029 के आम चुनावों से पहले महिलाओं के लिए 33 प्रतिशत आरक्षण लागू करना और लोकसभा सीटों की संख्या बढ़ाकर 850 तक करना है।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### संसद का शीतकालीन सत्र और परिसीमन से जुड़ा महिला आरक्षण विधेयक

केंद्र सरकार दिसंबर के पहले सप्ताह में संसद का शीतकालीन सत्र बुलाने की योजना बना रही है, जिसमें परिसीमन और महिलाओं के राजनीतिक प्रतिनिधित्व से जुड़े संविधान संशोधन विधेयक को पारित कराने पर मुख्य ध्यान दिया जाएगा।

#### मुख्य उद्देश्य और प्रस्तावित प्रावधान
* **लोकसभा सीटों का विस्तार**: प्रस्तावित संविधान संशोधन का उद्देश्य परिसीमन के माध्यम से लोकसभा की अधिकतम सीट क्षमता को वर्तमान 543 से बढ़ाकर 850 तक करना है।
* **महिला कोटा का कार्यान्वयन**: यह संरचनात्मक विस्तार 2029 के लोकसभा चुनावों से पहले संसद और राज्य विधानसभाओं में महिलाओं के लिए 33 प्रतिशत आरक्षण लागू करने की सुविधा प्रदान करेगा।
* **प्रस्तावित परिसीमन फॉर्मूला**: सरकार राज्यों में लोकसभा सीटों में 50 प्रतिशत की वृद्धि करने पर विचार कर रही है, जबकि 1971 की जनगणना के आधार पर तय अंतर-राज्यीय सीट अनुपात को बनाए रखने का प्रस्ताव है ताकि दक्षिणी राज्यों की चिंताओं को दूर किया जा सके।

#### लोकसभा में संख्याबल का गणित
* **विशेष बहुमत की आवश्यकता**: संविधान संशोधन विधेयक पारित करने के लिए उपस्थित और मतदान करने वाले सदस्यों के दो-तिहाई बहुमत की आवश्यकता होती है, जो 543 सदस्यीय लोकसभा में 361 वोट बैठता है।
* **वर्तमान सदस्य संख्या**: 3 रिक्तियों के कारण वर्तमान में लोकसभा सदस्यों की संख्या 540 है।
* **गठबंधन की स्थिति**: सत्तारूढ़ एनडीए के पास 320 सदस्य हैं और उसे 361 के आंकड़े तक पहुंचने के लिए विपक्ष के समर्थन की आवश्यकता होगी। हालांकि, सरकारी सूत्रों को 15 से 18 वोटों के अंतर से विधेयक पारित होने का भरोसा है।
* **पिछला प्रयास**: इससे पहले 17 अप्रैल को आयोजित एक विशेष बैठक के दौरान यह विधेयक आवश्यक संख्याबल न जुटा पाने के कारण पारित नहीं हो सका था।

#### पिछले सत्र की प्रक्रियात्मक स्थिति
* **सत्रावसान न होने का रिकॉर्ड**: पिछला मानसून सत्र 13 अगस्त को अनिश्चित काल के लिए स्थगित (sine die) कर दिया गया था और 94 दिनों तक सत्रावसान (prorogue) नहीं हुआ, जिसने 2008 के 87 दिनों के रिकॉर्ड को तोड़ दिया।
* **नोटिस से जुड़े नियम**: संसदीय नियमों के तहत, अनिश्चित काल के लिए स्थगित सत्र की विस्तारित बैठक केवल 2 दिनों के नोटिस पर बुलाई जा सकती है, जबकि नया सत्र बुलाने के लिए कम से कम 14 दिनों के नोटिस की आवश्यकता होती है।
* **संवैधानिक प्रावधान**: भारतीय संविधान में अनिश्चित काल के लिए स्थगन के बाद राष्ट्रपति द्वारा सत्र के सत्रावसान के लिए कोई निश्चित समय सीमा निर्धारित नहीं है।

#### राजनीतिक चुनौतियां
* विपक्षी दल मतदाता सूचियों के विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण (SIR) के खिलाफ अभियान चला रहे हैं और मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार के इस्तीफे की मांग कर रहे हैं, जिससे आगामी सत्र में हंगामे के आसार हैं।

news.exam_corner_topic: Cockroach Janta Party Zonal Appointments and State Committees
news.headline: Cockroach Janta Party Announces Zonal Leadership and State Coordination Committees
news.story_lead: The youth-led Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) has announced key zonal leadership appointments and constituted coordination committees across 10 states and regions to expand its grassroots setup. As part of its structural expansion, the organization named zonal in-charges for the West and North zones alongside state-level bodies of varying sizes.
news.full_article_text:
### Zonal Appointments and Structural Expansion

In a strategic effort to expand its organizational footprint, the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) announced the creation of zonal leadership roles and coordination committees across 10 states and regions on Saturday.

Key zonal appointments include:
- **West Zone In-Charge:** Kshitij Pagar
- **North Zone In-Charge:** Dr. Vivek Sangwan
- **North Zone Coordination Committee Members:** Muhammad Junaid and Geegraj Jorli

### Composition of State Coordination Committees

To manage regional activities and enhance grassroots engagement, CJP established coordination committees with varying membership sizes across ten jurisdictions:
- **Uttar Pradesh:** 16 members
- **Maharashtra:** 15 members
- **Jharkhand:** 14 members
- **Northeast Region:** 14 members
- **Bihar:** 13 members
- **West Bengal:** 12 members
- **Haryana:** 6 members
- **Uttarakhand:** 6 members
- **Rajasthan:** 5 members
- **Jammu and Kashmir:** 4 members

### Background and Past Agitations

Founded by Abhijeet Dipke in May 2026, the CJP originated as a satirical digital platform in response to public remarks by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant concerning unemployed youth. It gradually evolved into a student and youth mobilization movement focusing on paper leaks, employment issues, and systemic examination reforms.

 major actions by the group include a 36-day protest at Delhi's Jantar Mantar regarding the NEET-UG paper leak case, demanding political accountability which preceded the resignation of then Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan on July 25. The outfit has also raised concerns regarding the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, and participated in the opposition alliance's rally in Delhi on November 1.
news.background_context: The Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) was founded by Abhijeet Dipke in May 2026 as a digital initiative following comments made by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant regarding unemployed youth. It transformed into a youth movement addressing examination irregularities and electoral roll revision procedures.
bullet_points: CJP appointed Kshitij Pagar as West Zone in-charge and Dr Vivek Sangwan as North Zone in-charge.
Muhammad Junaid and Geegraj Jorli were inducted as North Zone Coordination Committee members.
State coordination committees were instituted across 10 states and regions.
Uttar Pradesh has the largest committee with 16 members, followed by Maharashtra (15) and Jharkhand (14).
The Northeast committee comprises 14 members, Bihar 13, and West Bengal 12 members.
Smaller committees were created for Haryana (6), Uttarakhand (6), Rajasthan (5), and Jammu & Kashmir (4).
The party emerged in May 2026 after comments by CJI Surya Kant regarding unemployed youth.
CJP led a 36-day protest at Jantar Mantar over the NEET-UG paper leak prior to Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's July 25 resignation.
The group is also actively protesting the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.

news.upsc_analysis: The evolution of the Cockroach Janta Party highlights the growing influence of digital-first youth mobilizations in Indian civil society. Originating from online discourse on youth unemployment, the movement transitioned into organized agitations around public exam integrity (NEET-UG) and electoral administration (SIR of voter lists). The creation of structured zonal and state coordination committees marks a phase of institutionalization from an informal protest group into a formalized political pressure organization.

Irregularities and paper leaks in public examinations like NEET-UG sparked street-level mobilizations.
impacts: Establishment of structured regional leadership across 10 Indian states and territories.
Increased public attention on paper leak accountability and electoral roll revision processes.
challenges: Sustaining organizational cohesion while transitioning from a digital pressure group to a traditional state-level structure.

hindi_translation.headline: कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी ने आंचलिक नियुक्तियों और 10 राज्यों में समन्वय समितियों की घोषणा की
hindi_translation.story_lead: युवा केंद्रित संगठन कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी (CJP) ने अपने संगठनात्मक विस्तार के तहत 10 राज्यों और क्षेत्रों में जोनल प्रभारियों की नियुक्ति की है और समन्वय समितियों का गठन किया है। संगठन ने पश्चिमी और उत्तरी जोन के लिए प्रभारियों के साथ-साथ विभिन्न राज्यों के लिए समितियों के सदस्यों की घोषणा की।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### आंचलिक नियुक्तियां और संगठनात्मक विस्तार

अपने संगठनात्मक आधार को मजबूत करने के उद्देश्य से कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी (CJP) ने शनिवार को 10 राज्यों और क्षेत्रों में आंचलिक पदों और समन्वय समितियों की स्थापना की घोषणा की।

प्रमुख आंचलिक नियुक्तियां निम्नलिखित हैं:
- **पश्चिम जोन प्रभारी:** क्षितिज पगार
- **उत्तर जोन प्रभारी:** डॉ. विवेक सांगवान
- **उत्तर जोन समन्वय समिति सदस्य:** मोहम्मद जुनैद और गीगराज जोरली

### राज्य समन्वय समितियों का गठन

विभिन्न क्षेत्रों में गतिविधियों के संचालन और जमीनी उपस्थिति बढ़ाने के लिए पार्टी ने 10 राज्यों और क्षेत्रों में समन्वय समितियां गठित की हैं:
- **उत्तर प्रदेश:** 16 सदस्य
- **महाराष्ट्र:** 15 सदस्य
- **झारखंड:** 14 सदस्य
- **पूर्वोत्तर क्षेत्र:** 14 सदस्य
- **बिहार:** 13 सदस्य
- **पश्चिम बंगाल:** 12 सदस्य
- **हरियाणा:** 6 सदस्य
- **उत्तराखंड:** 6 सदस्य
- **राजस्थान:** 5 सदस्य
- **जम्मू और कश्मीर:** 4 सदस्य

### पृष्ठभूमि और प्रमुख प्रदर्शन

अभिजीत दिपके द्वारा मई 2026 में स्थापित CJP की शुरुआत एक व्यंग्यात्मक ऑनलाइन अभियान के रूप में हुई थी। यह भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश सूर्य कांत द्वारा बेरोजगार युवाओं को लेकर की गई टिप्पणी के बाद शुरू हुआ था। बाद में यह परीक्षा धांधली और युवा बेरोजगारी के मुद्दों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करने वाले आंदोलन में बदल गया।

संगठन ने NEET-UG पेपर लीक मामले को लेकर दिल्ली के जंतर-मंतर पर 36 दिनों का विरोध प्रदर्शन आयोजित किया था, जिसके बाद तत्कालीन शिक्षा मंत्री धर्मेंद्र प्रधान ने 25 जुलाई को इस्तीफा दे दिया था। इसके अतिरिक्त, संगठन ने मतदाता सूची के विशेष गहन पुनरीक्षण (SIR) का विरोध करते हुए मुख्य चुनाव आयुक्त ज्ञानेश कुमार के इस्तीफे की मांग भी की है।
hindi_translation.background_context: कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी की स्थापना मई 2026 में अभिजीत दिपके ने की थी। यह संगठन बेरोजगार युवाओं पर सीजेआई सूर्य कांत की टिप्पणी के बाद एक डिजिटल अभियान के रूप में शुरू हुआ और बाद में प्रतियोगी परीक्षाओं में अनियमितताओं के खिलाफ एक युवा आंदोलन बन गया।

मोहम्मद जुनैद और गीगराज जोरली को उत्तर जोन समन्वय समिति का सदस्य बनाया गया।
10 राज्यों और क्षेत्रों में राज्य समन्वय समितियों का गठन किया गया।
उत्तर प्रदेश समिति में सबसे अधिक 16 सदस्य हैं, इसके बाद महाराष्ट्र (15) और झारखंड (14) हैं।
पूर्वोत्तर समिति में 14 सदस्य, बिहार में 13 और पश्चिम बंगाल में 12 सदस्य शामिल हैं।
हरियाणा (6), उत्तराखंड (6), राजस्थान (5) और जम्मू-कश्मीर (4) के लिए छोटी समितियां बनाई गईं।
यह संगठन मई 2026 में एक व्यंग्यात्मक ऑनलाइन पहल के रूप में शुरू हुआ था।
CJP ने NEET-UG मामले पर जंतर-मंतर पर 36 दिनों का प्रदर्शन किया था।
